title: Nanak: My Honor And Glory Are Yours,
summary: The shabad does not leave loneliness at diagnosis. It turns toward return.
takeaway: my honor and glory are Yours, God
lifeApplication: Name the companionship the line is restoring before the mind insists it is alone. After the reaction, make the next return smaller and truer.

source.shortMeaning: I am Your servant; You are my Lord and Master; my honor and glory are Yours, God
source.lifeApplication: Return begins when the later line is allowed to outlast the first rush of feeling.

evidence.coreClaim: I am Your servant; You are my Lord and Master; my honor and glory are Yours, God
evidence.turn: Loneliness steadies when my honor and glory are Yours, God.
